precedence: conflicting official identifier is a hard CONFLICT
competing canonical candidates or facility collision is AMBIGUOUS_CANONICAL_MATCH
unique exact normalized name plus distance <=250m is PROPOSED_CANONICAL_MATCH
unique source-token-subset name plus distance <=100m is PROPOSED_CANONICAL_MATCH
high-value source complex with publisher geometry and no credible candidate is PROPOSED_NEW_TRANSPORT_PLACE
ordinary bus/coach source evidence defaults to SUPPORTING_SOURCE_ONLY
no-mode and taxi evidence defaults to NO_ACTION
hard_vetoes: proximity without compatible name or official identifier
generic source name without corroborating evidence
facility claimed by multiple distinct source complexes
unresolved source hierarchy or unavailable source geometry for a decisive proposal
